You could move the addToMap() and getFromMap() methods here, or you could build an observer relationship between the ObjectWatcher and your createObject() methods. I’ll leave the details up to you. 8581.title: Here’s a concrete implementation
8581.code:
<?php
class VenueObjectFactory extends DomainObjectFactory
{
    public function createObject(array $row): Venue
    {
        $obj = new Venue((int)$row['id'], $row['name']);

        return $obj;
    }
}
